title: Brewer Won't Turn On
fullDescription: Bonavita brewer dead. Often thermal fuse blown after dry boil.

fixSteps.title: Replace fuse
fixSteps.instruction: Open base, replace thermal fuse if blown.

title: Cold Coffee
fullDescription: Heating element failed or descale needed.

title: Brewing Too Slow
fullDescription: Scale buildup restricts water flow. Run descale.

title: Water Leaking
fullDescription: Reservoir gasket worn or tank cracked.

fixSteps.title: Inspect tank
fixSteps.instruction: Remove tank and check for cracks.

title: Uneven Water Distribution
fullDescription: Showerhead holes blocked by scale or grounds, causing channeling.

title: Brewer Won't Shut Off
fullDescription: Hot plate or button stuck. Unplug to stop.

title: Pre-Infusion Switch Stuck
fullDescription: Pre-infusion lever does not move freely. Clean dried coffee residue.

title: Brew Temperature Below SCA
fullDescription: Aged element or scale makes brew temp drop. Descale or replace.

title: Coffee Spills From Brew Basket
fullDescription: Too-fine grind or filter collapse causes overflow.

title: Brewing Temperature Too High
shortDescription: Brew temperature exceeded safe range — protective shutoff.
fullDescription: Bonavita brews at SCA-certified 198-205F. Thermistor reading above range triggers protective shutoff to avoid scorching.

title: Water Flow Restriction
shortDescription: Water flow rate below threshold for proper extraction.
fullDescription: Bonavita uses a flat shower head requiring proper flow. Restriction yields under-extraction or short pour.

title: Steam Vent Blocked
shortDescription: Pre-infusion steam vent blocked — pre-wet phase incomplete.
fullDescription: Bonavita Connoisseur uses a brief pre-wet pre-infusion. Blocked vent disrupts the bloom phase.

title: Pump Loud or Erratic
fullDescription: Vibration pumps in Bonavita machines should hum smoothly. Air, scale, or wear cause noise.

title: Power Cycling Mid-Brew
fullDescription: Power cycling indicates electrical issue: outlet, cord, or thermal cutout intermittent.

fixSteps.title: Inspect cord
fixSteps.instruction: Look for damage or loose plug.

title: Shower Head Drip After Brew
shortDescription: Shower head continues dripping after brew complete.
fullDescription: Some dripping is normal as remaining water clears. Excessive drip indicates valve seal or pressure issue.
videoSearchQuery: Bonavita shower head drip after brew

title: Flat Filter Basket Misseated
shortDescription: Flat-bottom filter basket not aligned causing channeling.
fullDescription: Bonavita uses flat-bottom basket; off-center basket disrupts extraction.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Center basket in carafe lid hole.

title: One Cup Mode Stuck
shortDescription: One-cup mode does not engage shorter brew time.
fullDescription: On Connoisseur, one-cup button shortens pre-wet and brew. If mode does not change, switch may be stuck.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: If LED stays off, switch replacement.

title: Warming Cycle Auto-Off
shortDescription: Thermal carafe warming cycle ends prematurely.
fullDescription: BV1900TS uses passive thermal carafe; alleged warming cycle is the heater preheat — auto-off after brew is normal.
videoSearchQuery: Bonavita thermal carafe how long stays hot

title: No Bloom Pre-Infusion
shortDescription: Pre-infusion bloom phase missing or short.
fullDescription: Pre-wet phase wets grounds for 30s before main pour. Missing bloom indicates quick-brew mode or hardware issue.
symptoms: No pause between pre-wet and main pour

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: If bloom always missing, valve service.
